name: paper-tick
prompt: A soft single dry tick of a fingernail flicking a sheet of thick paper, close and very short.

name: wooden-tok
prompt: One short warm knock of a small wooden game piece tapped once on a wooden board.

name: error-thud
prompt: A muted low thud of a soft mallet on a padded table, dull and gently discouraging.

name: die-rattle
prompt: A single wooden die rattling in a cupped hand, then landing, bouncing once and settling on a wooden board.

name: wooden-steps
prompt: Three quick light hops of a small wooden pawn stepping across a wooden game board, evenly spaced.

name: match-chime
prompt: A match striking and flaring with a soft crackle, followed by a small warm brass chime.

name: taiko-hit
prompt: A single dramatic taiko festival drum strike with deep booming resonance and a sharp skin slap.

name: bell-arpeggio
prompt: Four bright small temple bells rising in a quick cheerful arpeggio, shimmering festival tone.

name: sparkle-rise
prompt: A rising magical sparkle shimmer of tiny bells sweeping upward, light and airy.

name: fizzle-poof
prompt: A small flame fizzling out with a sad descending sigh and a soft poof of smoke.

name: breath-whoosh
prompt: A soft gentle breathy whoosh of air passing through thin fabric.

name: paper-slide
prompt: A sheet of paper sliding gently across a polished wooden table.

name: festival-fanfare
prompt: A cheerful festival fanfare of bright plucked strings and small bells rising to a triumphant finish.

name: minor-cadence
prompt: A gentle sympathetic descending cadence of soft plucked strings, calm and warm, not punishing.

name: soft-ping
prompt: A single soft high ping of a small crystal glass being tapped gently.

name: reverse-slide
prompt: A reversed tape-like whoosh sliding upward, like a short sound being pulled backwards.
